description: Read an approval request and its status. Use when after request_approval, to learn whether the person approved it. Before: an approval id from request_approval. Returns the request: pending, approved, denied, completed, failed or expired (send request_approval again), with job_id or error_code once done; for functions.deploy the summary holds the public url; get_function_job needs job read access; after backend.create, list_databases shows the new database (needs Backend access and database read access). Cost: free.
name: get_approval
title: Read an approval request
